description: Muse Patches 0.7.14 — fix for the 'アフィ外して開く' button: the entity walk was one level too shallow and reported 'このポストにリンクはありません' on posts that do have links (e.g. yahoo.jp short links). The walk now goes deeper and reads the app's entity holder directly. Includes 0.7.13's 'Hide menu items' patch.
